states: Two invitations with the same display name, different exact IDs and different roles.
First Decline activates the review only. The exact ID, invited role, consequence and both choices fit on desktop and phone.
A confirmed decline keeps waiting and readback distinct. A fresh list keeps the other invitation and its actions.
An unconfirmed response preserves the existing stale-list warning, Check again and Sign out.
interactions: Desktop Enter opens the review with Keep invitation focused. Tab is contained. Escape or Enter on Keep restores the exact row action and sends nothing.
Phone tap opens the review. Keep returns to the exact row and sends nothing. Confirm sends one decision for the chosen ID.
After an unconfirmed decline, Check again runs read-only bootstrap and inbox calls without resending the decision. Accept still sends its existing single request with no dialog.
evidence_summary: Twelve actual production App journeys across base and candidate with identical synthetic HTTP fixtures, Playwright 1.56.1. Ten comparable state pairs inspected natively. No installed service or external identity provider tested.
